answer: By the reef of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. Work waits on the lotus until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the plume of the next round. Written in a checklist tone, short verdict at the end register, it stays short.
